codeReview.summary: The feature implements VAL-CROSS-001 (group selection creates visits) and VAL-CROSS-002 (sale links back to visit) correctly. However, VAL-CROSS-003 (offline visit creation syncs when online) is NOT implemented - the code makes direct API calls without any offline-first logic (no isOnline() check, no useOfflineAwareMutation). This is a blocking issue because the Avileo app is designed as offline-first and VAL-CROSS-003 explicitly requires offline visit creation.

issues.description: VAL-CROSS-003 not implemented: handleCreateSingleVisita() makes direct API call without checking isOnline() first. According to project conventions (AGENTS.md), offline-first features must check isOnline() before API calls.
VAL-CROSS-003 not implemented: handleCreateGroupVisitas() makes direct bulk API call without checking isOnline(). This fails the requirement 'Offline visit creation syncs when online'.
VAL-CROSS-003 not implemented: handleMarkAsPurchased() and handleMarkAsNotPurchased() make direct API calls without offline-first logic.
VAL-CROSS-003 not implemented: handleGenerateSale() navigates to sale page without offline-first handling.
use-visitas.ts uses plain useMutation without offline-aware wrapper. Should use useOfflineAwareMutation for offline-first support per project conventions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The AGENTS.md in mission directory explicitly states 'Offline-first: check isOnline() before API calls' as a key pattern, but the worker did not follow this for visit creation. The visits page makes direct API calls without checking connectivity.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: packages/app/app/routes/_protected.visitas.tsx:142-450 - All mutation functions (handleCreateSingleVisita, handleCreateGroupVisitas, handleMarkAsPurchased, handleMarkAsNotPurchased) call apiCall directly without isOnline() check

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature specifies skillName 'frontend-worker' but this skill doesn't exist in .factory/skills/ directory. The worker may not have had proper guidance on offline-first implementation.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The codebase has existing patterns for offline-first: useOfflineAwareMutation hook, useSync() hook with isOnline state. The worker should have used these but didn't. This knowledge exists in AGENTS.md files but wasn't applied.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: packages/app/app/hooks/AGENTS.md documents useOfflineAwareMutation pattern; packages/app/AGENTS.md documents useSync() and isOnline checks
